h1: Custom White T Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom White T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom white t shirts in bulk. Perfect for events, teams, and uniforms. Free setup and proofs at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: White t shirts are the most versatile blank for custom decoration, providing a crisp backdrop that makes screen-printed logos and embroidered designs stand out. Whether you need unisex poly-rich tees for a company picnic or tri-blend styles for a soft, premium feel, white shirts work with every decoration method from heat transfer to direct-to-garment. Bulk orders keep your per-unit cost low while ensuring consistent color across all sizes.
heroAltText: Stack of custom white t shirts with printed logo, perfect for corporate events and team uniforms
